_meta.method: Compiled from English Wikipedia entries on the Five Houses of Chan ancestral temples and major modern Chan training monasteries. Coordinates from Wikipedia infoboxes; flagged in notes when approximate.
_meta.coverageEstimate: Ancestral seats of the Linji, Caodong, and Yunmen schools plus the most-prominent modern Chan revival monasteries. Many smaller historic temples (especially in Sichuan, Fujian, Yunnan) and contemporary Chan-training monasteries omitted.
knownGaps: Many provincial Chan training monasteries (Sichuan, Fujian, Yunnan, Hunan)
Most Chan ancestor sites in poor preservation (Guishan, Yangshan)
Most temples primarily oriented to Pure Land or scholastic Buddhism even though historically Chan-affiliated

places.name: Linji Temple (Linji Yuan)
places.lineage: Chinese Chan (Linji — ancestral seat of the Linji house)
places.address: Linji Lu, Zhengding County, Shijiazhuang, Hebei
places.notes: Zhengding County documents the temple as the ancestral temple of the Linji school; published visitor hours are not a meditation schedule (checked 2026-10-08).

places.name: Bailin Chan Temple
places.address: Bailin Si, Zhao County, Shijiazhuang, Hebei 051530
places.notes: The monastery’s official site identifies its Linji transmission and continuing Life Chan education and retreat program; consult the current calendar for dates (checked 2026-10-08).

places.name: Zhenru Chan Temple (Yunju Shan)
places.address: Yunju Mountain, Yongxiu County, Jiujiang, Jiangxi
places.notes: The monastery’s official site publishes its International Chan Training Institute and retreat notices; consult the current calendar because no later 2026 retreat date was confirmed (checked 2026-10-08).

places.name: Tiantong Temple
places.lineage: Chinese Chan (Caodong — historic — where Dōgen received transmission)
places.notes: Current visitor information supports the Ningbo monastery and older Buddhist reporting documents Chan retreat activity; no current public practice timetable was verified (checked 2026-10-08).

places.name: Asoka Temple (Ayuwang)
places.lineage: Chinese Chan (Linji — historic — where Eisai studied)
places.address: 1999 Wuxiang East Road, Yinzhou District, Ningbo, Zhejiang
places.notes: A Zhejiang provincial source identifies Ayuwang as a historic Chan Five Mountains temple. Current visitor information supports the Ningbo address, but no public meditation schedule was found.

places.name: Lingyin Temple
places.lineage: Chinese Chan (Linji — major historic Chan temple)
places.notes: The temple’s official site documents its Chan identity, Hangzhou location, and current activities; no regular public zazen timetable was confirmed (checked 2026-10-08).

places.name: Jingci Temple
places.lineage: Chinese Chan (Linji — Five Mountains historic temple)
places.address: 56 Nanshan Road, Xihu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang
places.notes: Hangzhou Buddhist Association documented a current 2025 temple event, supporting institutional activity at this historic Chan temple. No regular public meditation schedule was found.

places.name: Jinshan Temple
places.address: 62 Jinshan Road, Runzhou District, Zhenjiang, Jiangsu
places.notes: The Jiangsu Buddhist Association identifies Jiangtian Chan Temple at 62 Jinshan Road. No current public practice schedule was found.

places.name: Gaomin Temple
places.address: 5 Yangzi Jiangnan Road, Hanjiang District, Yangzhou, Jiangsu
places.notes: The Jiangsu Buddhist Association identifies Gaomin as a major Chan monastery, and a 2025 association report confirms current institutional activity. No regular public sitting schedule was found.

places.name: Xuedou Temple
places.address: Xuedou Mountain, Xikou Town, Fenghua District, Ningbo
places.notes: The Zhejiang Buddhist Association identifies this active Fenghua temple, its historic Chan affiliation, and Buddhist academy. No current public zazen timetable was verified (checked 2026-10-08).

places.name: Daming Temple
places.notes: The temple’s own history documents its Chan transmission. An older page lists weekly meditation, but no current public timetable was confirmed (checked 2026-10-08).

places.name: Hanshan Temple
places.address: Hanshansi Lu, Gusu District, Suzhou, Jiangsu
places.notes: The Jiangsu Buddhist Association identifies this active Suzhou temple with the Linji Chan tradition; no current public sitting schedule was confirmed (checked 2026-10-08).

places.name: Nanhua Chan Temple (Nanhua Si)
places.lineage: Chan (Nanhua Chan Temple, Sixth Patriarch Huineng)
places.address: Caoxi, 7 km southeast of Maba Town, Qujiang District, Shaoguan, Guangdong, China
places.notes: Shaoguan government identifies this active Caoxi monastery with Huineng and Southern Chan heritage. No current public meditation timetable was verified (checked 2026-10-08).
